title: Webhook retries & signatures
tagline: Retry delays start too high, every delay hits the cap, and failed deliveries stay pending.
lookFor: `2 ^ n` is NOT 2 to the power n in JavaScript. Use `2 ** n`.
To set a top limit, use `Math.min(value, limit)`.
'Stop after 5 tries' means try 5 is the last one: `>= 5`.
Hex codes can be in capitals. Make both sides lowercase before comparing.

bugs.symptom: First retry delay is 2000 ms instead of 1000
bugs.cause: `^` is a bit operation, not 'to the power of'. It also runs after `*`.

bugs.symptom: Delays are never below the cap
hints: Which one sets a TOP limit: Math.min or Math.max?

bugs.symptom: Delivery is still pending after 5 failures
hints: After the 5th failure, attempts = 5. Is `5 > 5` true?

bugs.cause: Signatures in capitals don't equal the lowercase version.
